org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-api.why: ADR-0154: log4j publishes its licence through a Bundle-License OSGi manifest header, and the resolved value arrives with the header's quoting and link attribute intact ("Apache-2.0";link="..."). The licence is not in doubt; only its spelling is.

org.apache.logging.log4j:log4j-to-slf4j.why: ADR-0154: as log4j-api above — an OSGi Bundle-License header read verbatim.
